description: This file defines a React functional component 'ReportEdit' that provides a user interface for editing an existing report. It manages state for loading, error handling, and form submission, and interacts with an API to fetch and update report data. It also handles navigation within the application.

methods.name: ReportEdit
methods.description: Main React component for editing a report, handling data loading, form submission, and navigation.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles the form submission to update the report via API and navigates back to the report view.
